producer.evaluator: D-A4 two-variable Taylor/moment evaluator (K=36, J=40) of (92) with D-A5/D-A6 remainders; gamma by D-A7; prism-uniform balls by D-A15

inputs.form: D-A2: 10.50 weld (SPEC D-2.4) + 6.6(iv),(v) with delta_1 and N^{2|kappa|}

producer.mesh_policy: D-A16: 16 equal pieces per edge, bisection while hull radius |f'(z_m)|h + D_zz h^2/2 > 1/6 * min|f| (pre-scan 41 points/edge) or C6 fails
producer.hull_radius_policy: r = min(D-A10 |f'(z_m)|h + D_zz h^2/2, D-A10' |f'(z_m)|h + h^2/2 sup_seg|f''|); counts: 260 of 260 rows used D-A10'
producer.trust: UNTRUSTED producer; output enters the trusted statement only via H2-B
